policies.name: Active members read chat
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM member_profiles me
  WHERE ((me.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (me.status = 'active'::text) AND (me.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'member'::text])))))

policies.name: Active members send own chat
policies.check:
((sender_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM member_profiles me
  WHERE ((me.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (me.status = 'active'::text) AND (me.role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'member'::text]))))) AND ((char_length(btrim(body)) >= 1) AND (char_length(btrim(body)) <= 2000)))

policies.name: Sender or admin delete chat
policies.using:
((sender_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM member_profiles me
  WHERE ((me.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (me.role = 'admin'::text) AND (me.status = 'active'::text)))))
